description: Create a paid network session. This action incurs charges against the account balance. Configure a budget first and obtain owner approval for autonomous spend. The create API does not honor include_credentials and omits proxy credentials; read the session with include_credentials=true. Credentials are omitted unless include_credentials=true; never log them. PRICE_MISMATCH (409: re-read prices, retry once). BUDGET_EXCEEDED and INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE (402: ask the owner, don't retry).
name: nexalayer_create_session
